player_prompt.intro:
U tirhisa Blackjack na dealer.
Kongomiso ya wena i ku fikela 21 handle ko ya henhla.
Loko i vula ya wena, khetha '[Hit]' ku koka karta n'wana kumbe '[Stand]' ku khoma.
J/Q/K = 10 pointi; A = 11 kumbe 1, leyi yi n'wi vonakela.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Khomelo ra u rile ra xiyengxa. Usa '[Hit]' kuya '[Stand]'.
